semantic.justification: Original FastParser wraps the actual existing SAX parser/token owner, transitional/strict namespace maps, genuine InputSource and Reference stream owners. InputStreamCloseGuard retains the original input before callbacks; default false preserves open streams, explicit true closes during success/unwind, catches and destroys only actual UNO Exception values and releases its retained Reference afterwards. Input/name forwarding retains the original false default and system ID. Complete native UNO handler/token services, genuine StorageBase overload and package migration remain pending; no fake model/storage/query/service provider is introduced. Native unreachable null-parser guards, ABI/threading/constructor-failure unwind and native termination semantics for unrelated host errors remain unverified. Complete DOCX/XLSX filter/model/worker/UI integration remains incomplete.
